extraction.format: verbatim HTML fragments from successful official-page responses
extraction.selection: GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra row pairs; Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 4 Argon rows with their complete attached pricing footnotes; MAI-Code-1.1-Flash row; matching supported-model GA rows and MAI footnote
extraction.assembly: Retain the original h1 and pricing-unit paragraph, original table opening/header/body markup and selected whole tr elements, and whole attached li footnotes. Omit all navigation, scripts, unrelated rows and enclosing page layout; join fragments with newlines. No retained cell or footnote content is rewritten.
extraction.hashes: sha256 pins the original complete HTTP response at retrievedAt; fragmentSha256 independently pins the retained fixture bytes. The complete response is not retained.

sources.scope: GitHub Copilot / copilot-api billing, USD per million tokens; no CLI eligibility or native-provider inference
